extDescription.message: Save webpages as a PDF on your device. Full-page capture, browser print and page cleanup. By Mulham Kassab.

commandExport.message: Save the current page as PDF using your last settings

pagePdfMaybe.message: This looks like a PDF file. If Chrome is showing it in its PDF viewer, use the viewer’s download button instead.

pageInternal.message: Browser pages like Settings, Extensions and New Tab can’t be saved. Open a normal webpage first.

pageStore.message: The browser blocks extensions on its own web store pages. Open a different webpage first.

pageOther.message: webTopdf works on normal webpages (http or https). Open one first.

modeVisualDesc.message: The page as you see it, captured into a PDF. Keep this tab active during capture.

modePrintDesc.message: Use Chrome’s print layout for selectable text. Choose Save as PDF in the print dialog; results depend on the site.

toggleImages.message: Preload images with a short scroll

pickAndHideTitle.message: Click elements on the webpage to hide them. Press Escape to stop.

shortcutNext.message: Next time: $1 to save with these settings.

shortcutSet.message: Set a quick-save shortcut at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

noResponse.message: webTopdf did not respond. Please try again.

helpPrivate.message: Private questions? Use the developer email on the webTopdf Chrome Web Store listing.

errorLayoutUnstable.message: This page keeps changing its layout while it is scrolled. Try Print mode or Current view.

doneScrollPanel.message: This page scrolls inside a panel, so the PDF shows that panel’s full content.

doneGrew.message: The page grew while it was being captured, so the PDF stops at the length it had when the export started.

errorScrollPanel.message: This page scrolls inside a panel that webTopdf can’t capture in one piece. Use Current view or Print instead.

errorLostPage.message: webTopdf lost contact with the page. Reload the tab and try again, or use Print mode.

errorNoAccess.message: The browser did not allow webTopdf to use this page. Click the webTopdf button on the page again, reload it, or use Print mode.

errorQuota.message: The browser is limiting screenshots right now. Wait a few seconds and export again.

errorTabGone.message: The tab or window was closed during the export. Open the page and export again.

errorTabChanged.message: Export stopped because you switched tabs, windows, or navigated. Return to the page and export again.

errorIsPdf.message: This page is a PDF file. Use the PDF viewer’s download button to save it.

errorFileAccess.message: Enable “Allow access to file URLs” in webTopdf extension details to export local files.

errorNoRun.message: Chrome does not allow webTopdf to run on this page. Try a normal webpage.

errorNoResponse.message: The page did not respond. Reload it and try again.

errorPdfNoResponse.message: PDF processing did not respond. The page may be too large for this quality; try Compact quality, Current view or Print mode.

errorTooLarge.message: This page is too large to turn into a PDF at this quality. Choose Compact quality, Current view or Print mode.

errorResized.message: The browser window changed size during capture. Keep its size steady and try again.

errorNoScroll.message: This page prevented scrolling to the next section. Try Print mode or Current view.

errorScrolled.message: The page was scrolled during capture. Keep the page still and export again.

doneShifted.message: Content was added above your position while the page was captured. Check the PDF for repeated or missing parts.

doneWide.message: This page is very wide, so the PDF shows it small. Landscape orientation or Current view may read better.

errorDownload.message: Chrome could not finish the download. Export again or check your Downloads panel.

errorInterrupted.message: The previous export was interrupted. The page has been restored; please try again.

errorWait.message: Wait for the current export to finish.

pickHint.message: Pick & hide: click an element, or press Tab and the arrow keys to move the outline, Enter to hide it, Escape to stop.

errorSessionEnded.message: The page capture session ended. Please export again.

errorNoArea.message: This page has no usable capture area.

errorViewportSmall.message: The browser viewport is too small to capture.

errorTooLong.message: This page is too long to capture safely. Choose Current view, or export a smaller section.

errorTooManyTiles.message: This page needs more than $1 captures. Choose Current view, zoom out, or use Print mode.

errorCanvas.message: Chrome could not allocate a PDF page canvas. Try Compact quality.

errorPageMissing.message: A captured PDF page is missing. Please try again.

errorPageOrder.message: PDF pages arrived out of order. Please try again.

errorPdfLibrary.message: The bundled PDF library is missing. Reinstall webTopdf from the complete ZIP.

errorPdfSession.message: The PDF processing session ended. Please export again.
